<thought>Using the list of functional groups, I searched for templates that break a t‑butyldimethylsilyl group and form an aliphatic hydroxyl. The search returned a template with reaction_id 29646, which serves as the template_id, and provided the mapped reaction SMILES. This template corresponds to the retrosynthetic step of adding a TBS protecting group to the alcohol.</thought>
